## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL market regime. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive — Sector Weakness. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology); confirmation: very weak sector breadth and mixed mega-cap trends (MSFT ABOVE TREND vs AAPL BELOW TREND and JPM BELOW TREND) supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation posture.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads on 1W performance: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +2.29%) ABOVE TREND. Materials show one outsized winner DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND but sector internals are weak.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Industrials, Financials and Materials lag: UNP (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND — broad weakness across cyclicals on the week.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +8.54% | 1M: -7.53%) RECOVERY; ROST (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +11.63%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +6.43% | 1M: -2.50%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: UPS (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.79%) BELOW TREND; PPG (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND; BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND; MDT (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -12.64%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -6.74% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials/Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Highest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.25%), AVGO (1W: +9.16%), INTC (1W: +8.54%). Major divergence present (NVDA, GOOGL, INTC, AMD, TSLA showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE; tactically disruptive to broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed internals with pockets of strength and many reversals: MSFT (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -0.35%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -6.13%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth weak overall (market breadth 1/11).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials broadly weak: JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -6.20%) BELOW TREND — downside across the major banks/cards; sector underperformance confirms caution.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive names uneven: JNJ (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND — some trend exhaustion but not broad leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor select Technology names that remain ABOVE TREND (AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor RECOVERY candidates (INTC (1W: +8.54% | 1M: -7.53%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -0.35%) RECOVERY); reduce exposure to weak Industrials/Materials laggards (UPS (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.79%) BELOW TREND, PPG (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow concentration and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AVGO (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +10.25% | 1M: +7.90%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UPS (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.79%) BELOW TREND; PPG (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -15.85%) BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (led by AVGO, SHOP) — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: Industrials and Financials (UNP (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -0.44%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -7.92%) BELOW TREND) — internals deteriorating.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: recovery confirmed if 1M trend turns positive (RECOVERY -> ABOVE TREND confirmation). AAPL: watch 1M trend breach to validate continued BELOW TREND action. AVGO: hold ABOVE TREND momentum; failure to sustain 1W gains would signal pullback. UPS: further 1W weakness would deepen BELOW TREND technical damage.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): FDA approvals cited; JNJ (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +2.09%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed by 1M strength despite short-week pullback. LLY (+60): oral obesity launch news; LLY (1W: -0.63% | 1M: -5.21%) BELOW TREND — positive news but price still lagging (divergence). TSLA (+55): China sales jump; TSLA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -2.89%) RECOVERY — sentiment aligns with short-run bounce.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
JPM (-50): credit concerns noted; JPM (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. BA (-50): delivery/wiring headwinds; BA (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. SBUX (-50): downgrade flow vs price strength; SBUX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines but price diverging (watch for distribution).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology). AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.16% | 1M: +2.90%) and SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.15% | 1M: +15.45%) showing relative strength while JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -10.44%) and UPS BELOW TREND (1W: -10.87% | 1M: -12.79%) show weakness. Key risk is the MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (multiple RECOVERY cases); news-driven moves (JNJ, LLY, TSLA) may produce tactical opportunities but await confirmation before shifting core exposure.
